title: (No AI) Blue Planet III is keeping the rough edges in the age of AI
author: Terrence O’Brien
content:
![A humpback whale breaching with the NYC skyline in the background.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/blue_planet_iii_episode_03_051_screengrab.avif?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

BBC's _[Blue Planet III](https://www.bbcearth.com/shows/blue-planet-iii)_ is looking to prove its authenticity by leaving in the less-than-perfect shots. Previous incarnations of the nature series were defined by their gorgeous, crystal-clear footage that seemed almost too good to be real. But one dead giveaway of AI is when things look too polished and seamless. To counter that, Blue Planet III goes warts and all.

Executive Producer Elizabeth White told _[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/media/2026/oct/24/blue-planet-iii-cloudier-footage-prove-authenticity-ai-boom)_ in the past, "the amount of plankton and things" floating in the water would have caused them to cut a shot. Or "we might have framed out a boat or a buoy or gone: 'Oh, actually … the water conditions are not really good enough …

title: (No AI) Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads
author: Terrence O’Brien
content:
![Illustration of ad broken by a gavel](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/09/STK445_ADVERTISING_STK093_GOOGLE_C.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

On Thursday, Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro signed the [Artificial Intelligence Deceptive Advertising Act](https://www.palegis.us/legislation/bills/text/PDF/2025/0/SB0806/PN1808) into law, requiring disclosures on AI-generated ads. The law requires any ad - whether it's a still image, video, audio, or text - that "has been significantly modified or generated by artificial intelligence" to include a label in the same format as the ad itself. That applies to [TV commercials from multi-billion-dollar companies](https://www.theverge.com/news/812559/coca-cola-ai-holiday-christmas-commercial-2025), as well as restaurants' [ugly, crowded flyers](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/989376/ai-generated-food-why-does-it-look-like-that) about their wing specials.

Pennsylvania is one of the first states to require disclosures on AI content. And it requires those labels regardless of where an ad …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1018187/pennsylvania-ai-deceptive-advertising-act)
